evals.name: explicit_rebuild_request
evals.prompt: Rebuild the portfolio knowledge graph with the latest data.
evals.expect_behavior: Runs src.knowledge.pipeline, verifies graph.json + metrics.json exist, returns node/edge/theme counts.

evals.name: llm_unreachable_fallback
evals.prompt: Refresh the portfolio brain, but the local LLM server is down.
evals.expect_behavior: Re-runs the pipeline with no_llm=true so compression degrades gracefully, and reports degraded mode.

evals.name: wrong_skill_question
evals.prompt: What hidden links connect my AI and energy holdings?
evals.expect_behavior: Does NOT build; defers to querying-portfolio-brain because this is a question, not a build request.

evals.name: stale_after_news_update
evals.prompt: News caches just updated — regenerate the LLM-wiki and graph.
evals.expect_behavior: Runs the build pipeline and surfaces refreshed metrics and artifact paths.
